verdict.rationale: The docs include a page titled "Send events directly to mParticle" and an HTTP APIs section under /developers/apis/http/, which suggests a documented direct ingestion path. The pack contains only titles, though, with no content describing the server-to-server endpoint, how requests are authenticated, or what delivery guarantees apply. Missing for 10: documented server-to-server HTTP events API details, authentication mechanism, delivery guarantees (retries/acknowledgement/ordering), independent or hands-on corroboration.
